name: bearhomebot
description: Lightweight Telegram gateway for Codex CLI and k-skill

scripts.build: node --eval "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npm run format:check && bash -n scripts/*.sh
scripts.test: node --eval "require('node:fs').rmSync('.runtime/test-dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test .runtime/test-dist/test/*.test.js
